thread:
sarah.sales: Heads-up — ProofWork signed the SOW for a 3-week pilot starting next Monday. Need a tight POC onramp: Hosted API keys for dev, a small Dedicated preview for an end-to-end load test, and VPC-peering as an option. They require a hard spend cap and daily audit exports. Can we stand this up by Monday morning? :calendar:

alicia-se: Yep. I can spin up a billing project + ephemeral keys. Need a few details from sales:
- final project name
- billing contact email (for invoices/alerts)
- hard cap amount in USD
- do they want the ephemeral key scoped to staging/dev endpoints only?
- preferred region for Dedicated preview

sarah.sales: Project name: proofwork-pilot-2024. Billing contact: j.martinez@proofwork.com. Hard cap: $7,500. Ephemeral keys to be dev-only (no production routes). They prefer eu-west1 for latency to their infra.

ben-platform: For the Dedicated preview — recommend reserving a 2-GPU slot (NVIDIA A10s) to simulate steady-state. Expected profile: model family ~13B, ~25 rps steady, bursts to ~100 rps for ~5-10m. We'll enable autoscale burst pool and set fallback to Hosted to avoid failing requests if they exceed burst capacity.

kevin-finops: I can allocate $7.5k credits and set a hard cap. Two possibilities for enforcement:
* Hard stop: API keys suspended once cap hits — safest for customer.
* Quota throttle: aggressive throttling + alerts before shutdown.
You said hard cap, so I'll mark as hard stop and enable daily spend export to the accounting bucket. I'll also tag the project with cost_center:sales_poc_proofwork.

sarah.sales: Hard stop is required per legal. Also they want daily audit CSV with token/route usage. Can we expose that? :mag_right:

alicia-se: Yes — we'll enable daily billing export + per-route usage logs. For API creds I'm creating ephemeral key bundle with 10-day TTL. Keys will be scoped to generation/chat endpoints only and limited to the project's quota. I'll put the key(s) in the secure project channel and note rotation instructions.

tom.sre: For VPC peering we'll need their VPC CIDR block, project ID, and a preferred maintenance window. Typical lead time: 48-72 hours after we get their info. For eu-west1 peering there are a couple of NAT IPs we'll share for their egress allowlist. If they insist on private control plane/on-prem, that's a 2-3 week engagement.

sarah.sales: I'll ask the customer for the VPC details but we'll proceed without peering initially. Customer asked about audit logs retention and SOC requirements — is that handled by our standard enterprise package or do we need a special add-on?

kevin-finops: Standard retention is 90 days; for longer retention we can enable premium logging (enterprise add-on). For the pilot, 90 days + daily CSV export should be fine. I'm also adding budget alerts at 50/80/95% so we're notified.

deploy-bot: ticket #POC-5711 created. Assignees: alicia-se, kevin-finops, tom.sre, ben-platform. Milestones: Hosted + credits ready in 24h, Dedicated preview reserved (pending confirmation), VPC peering scheduled after customer details.

alicia-se: Actioning now — creating project and ephemeral keys.
Command (internal tracking):

```
POST /internal/projects
name: proofwork-pilot-2024
owner: j.martinez@proofwork.com
region_pref: eu-west1
labels: [poc, sales-pilot]
spend_policy: hard_cap 7500
ephemeral_ttl_days: 10
```
I will scope keys to dev routes and TTL 10 days. Uploading keys to secure channel shortly.

kevin-finops: Credits applied and hard cap configured. Daily ledger export to gs://redwood-billing-exports/sales/poc_proofwork/ set up. Alerts at 50/80/95% enabled.

ben-platform: Reserved Dedicated preview window in eu-west1: 2x GPUs reserved for canary + burst pool. Autoscale bounds set, fallback route to Hosted model variant if bursts exceed capacity.

tom.sre: I'll wait for the customer's CIDR + project ID. Once received, I'll open the peering request and schedule a 2-business-day window. Will include our NAT IPs and required firewall rules.

sarah.sales: Perfect. Final deliverables I need to send the customer:
- onboarding link + quickstart for dev keys
- ephemeral key TTL and rotation steps
- confirmation of $7.5k credits + hard cap
- instructions for providing VPC CIDR + project ID if they want peering

alicia-se: Onboarding link (internal): https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/proofwork-pilot-2024
Ephemeral key TTL: 10 days. Keys uploaded to secure channel: #sec-proofwork-pilot (links attached in ticket).

sarah.sales: Thanks team — I'll email ProofWork now and attach the onboarding doc and the ticket. Will follow up here when they send CIDR. :white_check_mark:

---
Summary of action items:
- alicia-se: create billing project + ephemeral keys (in progress/done)
- kevin-finops: apply credits + hard cap + daily export (done)
- ben-platform: reserve Dedicated preview (done/pending)
- tom.sre: handle VPC peering once customer provides details (pending)
- sarah.sales: collect VPC info from customer and distribute onboarding materials (pending)
